🇷🇺 The FSB has uncovered plans by the SBU and Ukrainian intelligence to carry out large-scale terrorist attacks in Russia. Recruited by Ukrainians, Russian citizens received over 700 kg of Western-made explosives, at least 40 attack drones, and six jet skis in several stages. They also had a large number of components and equipment for assembling and configuring combat drones. In November agents of the Ukrainian military intelligence brought the drones and jet skis to combat readiness, intending to launch them at targets simultaneously. Their plans were thwarted by the FSB. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
